title: Nokia/Rooftop Cocreation Session
description: I was honored to be chosen as one of eight Maemo Community members to take part in a Nokia/Rooftop Cocreation session in Amsterdam, in which we dreamt up four mobile apps. Swipe to the end to see me speaking.

title: Written & Formatted
description: Embedded editor that converts simple plain-text markup into publication-ready, accessible HTML with sophisticated typographic features like drop caps, ligatures, footnotes, and more. Try it out!

Roles: Design, Development Try it out!
